title: Mat Rack and Slant-Board Preparation Zone
description: One static mat and slant-board preparation zone for the original fitness stretch-area program. Three complete existing models at original unit scale and identity orientation: full twin-peg hanging mat rack with both original whole mats at the rear-left, complete pierced fixed slant board on the front floor, and the original full-height changing locker at the rear-right with its fixed open door. The existing sports locker is reused whole, not renamed or counted as a new fitness prop. No mat is extracted from its rack or claimed compatible with other equipment. Whole raw GLB POSITION/NORMAL/index buffers, internal hierarchy and per-face PBR remain unchanged. Only one connected floor and cutaway boundary are new scene-only geometry. All original finite ground soles sit on the floor, the complete envelopes are mutually separated, and five conservative empty strips are connected. This is equipment storage/preparation beside a fixed board, not the old kettlebell shelf/mat exercise corner, sports rest scene, or a promise of a practical stretching station. One scene, zero new independent models. No mat removal, unfolding, elastic deformation, door motion, use demonstration, body fit, exercise benefit, therapeutic effect, human ergonomics, loading, anti-tip, locker security, installation or fitness safety is claimed.
